title: Enterprise Security Intake: Standardize Questionnaire Triage & Response Pathway
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: As Redwood expands sales into larger enterprises, the volume and complexity of incoming security/compliance questionnaires (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR DPAs and vendor security stacks) has increased dramatically. Currently responses are ad-hoc across PM, Solutions, Legal, and Engineering, creating slow SLAs (often >10 business days), inconsistent answers, and repeated rework.

Goal: Establish a lightweight, repeatable intake and triage workflow for security & compliance asks that reduces first-response SLA to 48 business hours, produces a definitive owner for each questionnaire, and creates standardized artifacts (templates, canonical answers, and a single-source-of-truth Confluence playbook) so that large enterprise deals are not blocked by avoidable questionnaire friction.

Scope: Non-bug requests originating from Sales/CS/Prospects that require security/compliance documentation or vendor questionnaire responses. Includes SOC2/ISO summaries, HIPAA attestation guidance, GDPR data processing addenda, and long-form vendor questionnaires (SIG, VSAQ-style). Excludes full legal contract negotiation and custom engineering changes that become feature work (those must route to ENG via a dependency).

Success metrics: 48h initial triage SLA, 7 business day median time-to-final-response for standard questionnaires, reduction in duplicate questions across customers by 60% via reuse of canonical answers, and increased NPS from Sales on security response satisfaction (baseline survey to be captured).
acceptance_criteria: Publish a Confluence 'Enterprise Questionnaire Playbook' covering intake steps, ownership matrix, and templates
Create a lightweight intake form (Form + Zendesk flow) that captures required metadata (customer, regulatory scope, deadline, data residency concerns, required artifacts)
Define and communicate SLA: 48 business hours for triage + assignment; target 7 business day resolution for standard questionnaires
Deliver canonical answer templates for SOC2, GDPR/DPA, HIPAA, and a SIG starter kit stored in the knowledge repo
Integrate a tracking label and ticketing convention so queries surface in PM/SEC/ENG dashboards and can be reported weekly
notes: Trade-offs: Fast triage requires defined heuristics to decide when an ask becomes engineering work vs. a documentation response. We'll rely on an intake rubric (sensitivity + change-scope + SLA) instead of deeply gating each request to avoid delays.

Ownership model: Primary owner will be PM (triage & coordination) with 'Subject Matter Experts' (SMEs) in Security, Legal, and Engineering assigned as needed. For dedicated customers requiring architecture changes, the ticket will create an ENG dependency with clear acceptance criteria.

Templates: Aim for modular answers (short answer + optional appendix) to accelerate reuse in long questionnaires (SIG/Standardized Assessments). Store canonical answers in Confluence and a markdown repo for programmatic insertion into responses.

implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): finalize intake form + playbook + canonical templates; Phase 2 (2 weeks): implement Zendesk flow + automate ticket labels and dashboarding; Phase 3 (Ongoing): iterate templates from real customer questionnaires and onboard Solutions team training.
risks: Understaffing of Security SMEs could cause missed SLAs — mitigate by identifying backup SMEs and documenting required evidence locations ahead of time
Private/on-prem customers have different evidence paths — must maintain a separate checklist and time expectations
Legal review cycles can extend time-to-response for DPAs — track as separate escalation path and communicate to Sales
